name: Dark Maverick Hunter - Zero Virus
desc:
Must be Special Summoned by the effect of "Maverick Boost - Virus Affect".
If this card is Special Summoned and your opponent controls more cards than you do: You can draw cards equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls, and if they control 5 monsters, this effect cannot be negated.
If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Maverick Hunter" or "Maverick Boost" card from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Dark Maverick Hunter - Zero Virus" once per turn.
strings: Draw cards equal to opponent's monsters
Add 1 Maverick Hunter or Boost card to hand
